summary: @cogdog this is why I love the microformats meta data we use for #IndieWeb stuff. It isn't hidden like in your examples or overly influenced by Google. Just human readable data right in HTML. The comments that the real juicy stuff. Knowledge not data.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
@cogdog this is why I love the microformats meta data we use for #IndieWeb stuff. It isn't hidden like in your examples or overly influenced by Google.

Just human readable data right in HTML.

The comments that the real juicy stuff. Knowledge not data.
